spans.s:
हेरिक, अस्, m. [cf. हैरिक], a spy, secret emis-
sary or agent, (said to be also written हेरक.)

हेरम्ब हेरम्ब, अस्, m., N. of Gaṇeśa; a
buffalo; a boastful hero (vain of his own valour); a
particular Buddha (= हेरुक).
—हेरम्ब-जननी,
[]
f. ‘mother of Gaṇeśa,’ Durgā.
—हेरम्ब-मन्त्र,
अस्, m. a particular Mantra (sacred to Gaṇeśa).
—हेरम्ब-हट्ट, अस्, m., N. of a country, (said
to be one of the provinces of the Deccan.)

हेरुक हेरुक, अस्, m. an attendant on
Mahā-kāla or Śiva; (with Buddhists) an inferior
Buddha.
